name: Plaguewood Tower
summary: Plaguewood Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower situated in the northern reaches of the Plaguewood near Terrordale. Shattered during the Scourge invasion, it now stands as a broken ruin amid the blighted forest.

sections.title: A Ruined Sentinel in the North
sections.body: Standing on the edge of the blight-choked Plaguewood and the blighted town of Terrordale, Plaguewood Tower once served the Kingdom of Lordaeron as a vital northern watchpost. When the Scourge swept across the land, the fortification was battered into crumbling masonry and left in ruins amid corrupted fungal canopies. Today the fractured stones still overlook the northern trails, a silent reminder of the watch Lordaeron once kept over this land.

faq.q: What was Plaguewood Tower originally used for?
faq.answer: Plaguewood Tower was built by the Kingdom of Lordaeron as a regional watchtower. Before the Third War, guards stationed here watched over the northern forests, roads, and settlements like Terrordale before the Scourge overwhelmed and shattered the garrison.

faq.q: Where exactly is the tower located?
faq.answer: It is positioned in the northern sector of the Eastern Plaguelands within the Plaguewood, just outside the ruined town of Terrordale and south of Stratholme's outer blighted reaches.

angles.text: For Alliance forces, reclaiming the shattered watchtowers of Lordaeron is both a logistical necessity for surviving the Plaguelands and a symbolic reclamation of fallen human lands.
For the Horde, ruined fortifications like Plaguewood Tower show how thoroughly the Scourge broke the defenses of the northern kingdoms.
